parts.title: Openness isn't restored with donor status
parts.body:
`hydrate_person` restores **donor status** but not openness, so a historical view shows today's value:

```python
person.openness = snapshot.openness
```

parts.title: Draft versions lose their label
parts.body:
`formatVersionLabel` returns an empty string when `publishedAt` is null, so drafts render with no label.

- Keep the `"Draft"` fallback
- Or return it from the helper
